verdict.rationale: The only evidence of any scheduling capability is the MCP tool surface listing snapshot management as "create/restore/schedule", implying Neon can schedule recurring database snapshots — but there's no evidence of a general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduler (e.g., cron-like task execution, scheduled function runs, or workflow orchestration) that an AI-native user could hook arbitrary automation into. missing for 10: a documented generic job/workflow scheduler, recurring trigger configuration beyond snapshots, and any independent confirmation of scheduled automation working end-to-end.
